description: This is a PHP test class file for OAuth2 API endpoint testing, demonstrating various login and token request scenarios using the Codeception testing framework.

classes.name: OAuth2Cest
classes.description: A test class for OAuth2 token authentication endpoints, including invalid login, client validation, grant type checks, and login scenarios.

methods.name: TestScenarioInvalidLogin
methods.description: Tests response for invalid login attempt with empty credentials.

methods.name: TestScenarioInvalidClient
methods.description: Tests response for invalid client credentials.

methods.name: TestScenarioGrantTypeNotAllowed
methods.description: Checks that only allowed grant types can be used for token requests.

methods.name: TestScenarioLoginWithPasswordGrant
methods.description: Tests login using password grant type, expecting to obtain a JWT token.

methods.name: TestScenarioLoginWithClientCredentialsGrant
methods.description: Tests login with client credentials grant type, then reverts to password grant login.
